senses.gloss: m. (denom. of סְפִינָה) sailor, captain of a freight ship.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:14">Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 14</cite>, a. e.—Pl. <he>סַפָּנִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 15:1">Sabb. XV, 1</cite>, sq. <he>קשר הס׳</he>, expl.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:14">Kidd. IV, 14</cite> <he>הס׳ רובן וכ׳</he> sailors are mostly pious men.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:7">Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>איכריו וסַפָּנָיו וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="A01137"><he>איבריו</he></cite>) his farm-hands, and the sailors and camel drivers in his employment.
